name: Necklace Recovery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
We've got work for you, that is if you've got the guts to do it!

Deep in the Badlands is the Uldaman dig site.  We've heard a tale about some idiot paladin who died there recently.  Why we even care is that he had a very valuable necklace on him.  It's supposedly got three large gems: a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz.

The shot: we want it, and we're payin' TOP SILVER to get it.  It may be damaged, but that's neither here nor there; we'll fix whatever scratches are on it.
narrative.objectives: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.  The necklace may be damaged.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Mmmm salvage!  I can smell the necklace from here.  Now let's look at that beauty...

Hey, what do you think you're trying to do here?  This necklace is missing the gems!  You think we wouldn't notice?  Even Malton could see that the gems are gone.

Well, maybe you didn't steal them... but this necklace is worthless without those gems!  Your job isn't done here yet, not by a long shot!
narrative.requestItemsText: Well, do you have the necklace?  You won't see a copper from us if you don't have that necklace!

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 41 to 44, 19,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.objectiveText: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.objectiveText: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.objectiveText: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.objectiveText: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Deliver the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
quests.objectiveText: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
